label: H.R. 1329
title: Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act

items.item: Reserve of the National Mall in Washington, DC
items.snippet: This bill authorizes the Smithsonian American Women's History Museum to be located on a particular site within the Reserve of the National Mall in Washington, DC. Specifically, the bill designates the South Monument site as the location for the museum;
however, the President may designate an alternative site within 180 days of the bill's enactment.

items.item: Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution
items.snippet: The Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution must have the approval of specified federal entities (e.g., the Commission of Fine Arts) to plan, design, and construct a museum building.
